title: diag.9: power — ADC calibration check and drain rate monitor
description: On boot, check nRF52840 FICR ADC calibration registers. If absent/default, report DIAG_POWER_ADC_UNCALIBRATED. Track battery voltage delta per hour. If drain rate > 2× expected for current duty cycle, report DIAG_POWER_HIGH_DRAIN. Detects floating GPIO pins and uncalibrated ADC.
